space_weather_events.educational_note: Coronal Mass Ejections (CMEs) hurl billion-ton clouds of plasma into space, requiring immediate shielding.
RadLab Data: Astronauts on the ISS receive about 10 times the radiation of a typical person on Earth.
NASA DONKI Alert: High-energy solar protons can penetrate spacecraft hulls, damaging sensitive life-support electronics.
Mars lacks a global dipole magnetic field, leaving its surface exposed to atmospheric stripping and induced currents.
Coronal holes channel fast solar winds exceeding 700 km/s, requiring full base power diversion to survival shields.
